services.name: Boston Harbor Sunset Cruise
services.desc: See the harbor at its finest as the sun sets behind the skyline and the building lights turn on. 1.5 Hours About There is something about getting away from the hustle and bustle of the city life and watching the sunset from Boston Harbor. Mass Bay Lines provides a sensational Boston Harbor sunset cruise that truly have taken the breath away from so many local residents and visiting tourists Enjoy the fresh air and escape the heat, see amazing views of Boston’s beautiful skyline and the historic USS Constitution as the sun sets behind the city. As evening sets in, sunset colors fade All Ages! • 1.5 Hours • Amazing views • Escape the hustle and bustle!

services.name: Boston Harbor Moonlight Cruise
services.desc: “Sea” the stars from a new perspective 1.5 Hours About Join us for a beautiful 90 minute evening cruise of Boston Harbor under the stars. View Boston’s beautiful skyline of lights. Whether you’re ending your evening onboard or starting your night out, come Sea Boston with Mass Bay Lines. More Info Drinks are available for pre-purchase and also available to purchase on board You are welcome to bring your own food. However, outside drinks are not All Ages! • 1.5 Hours • "Sea" the stars! •Enjoy the night skyline from the water!

services.name: Dog Days Of Summer Cruise
services.desc: Take your four-legged friends aboard a cruise around the Boston Harbor. Now the whole family can take and enjoy a boat ride! 1.5 Hours About Kick back, relax and enjoy some fresh air while you cruise around the harbor taking in all the sights and rich history with your four legged friend. You will enjoy views of the city, fish pier, Logan airport and the US Constitution to name a few. All dogs must be on a leash at all times. One dog for each paying adult. On the evening cruises, there will be light narration Cash bar and light snacks available for sale. More Info Drinks are All Ages! • 1.5 Hours • Take your four-legged friend on a cruise! • For the whole family!

services.name: Howl-O-Ween Doggy Costume Party
services.desc: All Paws on Deck! 2 Hours About Join pups and their owners for a special 2 Hour Howl-o-weenie Cruise around Boston Harbor! Dress you and your dog in your best costumes and join us for costume contests, treats, and more! We will also have light entertainment, a cash-only bar, and prizes to be awarded to the winners of each contest. More Info Drinks are available for pre-purchase and also available to purchase on board You are welcome to bring your own food. However, outside drinks are not All Ages! • 2 Hours • All Paws on Deck!

services.name: Full Moon Cruises
services.desc: Moonlight Cruise on the harbor. Enjoy a relaxing cruise while seeing Boston's skyline in the moonlight. 2 Hours About Mass Bay Lines offers a beautiful, relaxing 2-hour Full Moon cruise through Boston Harbor. “Sea” the stars from a new perspective. Enjoy an evening on the Boston Harbor with a beautiful view of the night sky. Look to the heavens and maybe even wish upon a shooting star. You don’t have to be an astronomer to appreciate a midsummer’s night sky with Boston’s world class silhouette in the background. Cash bar and light snacks available for sale. More Info Drinks are All Ages! • 2 Hours • Enjoy the Moonlight from the Water!

services.name: USS Constitution Turnaround Cruise
services.desc: Celebrate America while viewing the USS Constitution as she transits Boston Harbor 2.5 Hours About Celebrate America while viewing the USS Constitution as she transits Boston Harbor. "Old Ironsides", the oldest commissioned warship, passes Castle Island and fires a 21 gun salute on the Fourth of July. Join us for brunch! Enjoy a waffle bar, home fries, eggs, and sausages, with coffee and tea available. Spend a memorable and patriotic July 4th on the harbor. Cash bar with juice, soda, and other beverages available for sale Ages 5+ • July 4th • 2.5 Hours

services.name: Fireworks Cruise (Ages 21+)
services.desc: Book now! 2.5 Hours About Experience the city lights and Boston Harbor Fireworks while cruising and dancing to the DJ around the harbor! More Info Drinks are available for pre-purchase and also available to purchase on board You are welcome to bring your own food. However, outside drinks are not Ages 21+ • 2.5 Hours

services.name: Boston 250 - Hingham
services.desc: 2.5-hour waterfront cruise in Boston Harbor to view Tall Ships and celebrate the 250th anniversary of the United States. All Ages! • 2.5 Hours • Celebrate America •

The fleet consists of three distinct boats suitable for various event sizes and types.
